Reset control

Base Offset:

Size:

Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

DEVICE_RESET bytes 0-2 plus one pad byte. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_RESET. Firmware accesses the fields through cpuif; USB Recovery Agent writes use the hardware interface. Recovery FSM actions are qualified by the USB hardware write path, not by the firmware cpuif write.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:24] RESERVED_31_24 r 0x0 Reserved
[23:16] IF_CTRL rw 0x0 Interface Control
[15:8] FORCED_RECOVERY rw 0x0 Forced Recovery
[7:0] RESET_CTRL rw 0x0 Device Reset Control

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_24 - Reserved

Byte 3 is padding introduced by the DWORD-aligned RDL view and is not part of the OCP Recovery DEVICE_RESET command payload (OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_RESET is 3 bytes). Matches the clean reserved byte-3 pattern of RECOVERY_CTRL.

IF_CTRL - Interface Control

Byte 2 controls interface mastering enable. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_RESET.

FORCED_RECOVERY - Forced Recovery

Byte 1 controls forced recovery or flashless boot on the next platform reset (0xE = enter flashless boot mode, 0xF = enter recovery mode). OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 DEVICE_RESET.

RESET_CTRL - Device Reset Control

Byte 0 requests device reset or management reset. USB Recovery Agent writes use the hardware interface; firmware can read or clear the request through cpuif.
